test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: Which of the following articles of the Constitution directs the State to take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the State?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 50.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Separation of the judiciary from the executive **is guaranteed in** article 50 of the constitution. **
 
• Article 50 reported that** “the state shall take action to unconnected the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the state”.**
 
• **The Indian National Congress **desired the judiciary to be divided from the executive branch of the government.
 
• There is no arrangement in the Constitution that talks about the separation of powers** except Article 50** which talks about the separation of the executive from the judiciary but this doctrine is in practice in India.
 
• Article 50 provides a direction to the State to keep the Judiciary independent of the Executive, mainly in **judicial appointments.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 37** mentions a number of rights: No child shall be subjected to torture, cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment. No child should be unlawfully arrested or detained.
 
• **Article 57** regarded the eligibility conditions for the re-election of the President.
 
• **Article 47** of The Constitution of India is one of the Directive Principles which directs the State to increase the **level of nutrition and the standard of living** and to upgrade public health as among its primary duties and, in specific, the State shall effort to bring about prohibition of intoxicating drinks and drugs which are harmful to health.​
